The '''''Seeker''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was owned by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Almas Academy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Seeker'' appears in the [[Jedi Code trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign, where the player characters can use it if they don't have a ship of their own.
